info.title: ClinicalCare API
info.description: Clinical encounters (and, later, vitals). Every endpoint requires the shared X-Internal-Gateway-Secret header (ADR 0055, ADR 0064) -- there is no per-user authentication yet, so the acting provider is supplied by the caller.

post.summary: Create an encounter for a registered patient

get.summary: List one patient's encounters, newest first, one bounded page at a time

put.summary: Replace an encounter's editable fields, conditional on the ETag the caller read

get.summary: Get one encounter by its uuid

post.summary: Record a set of vital signs for an encounter

get.summary: List an encounter's vitals, newest first, one bounded page at a time

post.summary: Record a problem on a registered patient's list

get.summary: List one patient's problems, newest first, one bounded page at a time
Get one problem by its uuid, with an ETag

post.summary: Record an allergy on a registered patient's list

get.summary: List one patient's allergies, newest first, one bounded page at a time
Get one allergy by its uuid, with an ETag

InternalGateway.description: The shared secret configured by InternalGatewayOptions.Secret. Gates the service shut to anyone else; it does not identify which end user is behind the call.
InternalGateway.name: X-Internal-Gateway-Secret
